# Original analyzer fixtures

OriginalVariable.ttf, OriginalVariable.woff and OriginalCollection.ttc contain original procedural rectangle outlines generated by generate_variable.py. They are dedicated to the public domain under CC0-1.0. No third-party font outlines were copied. The variable font has a real gvar stem delta, named weights, and GPOS pair/class fixtures. Rust tests also construct original geometric, humanist, serif and mono outlines in memory.

Regenerate with Python + fontTools: `python generate_variable.py`. Binary timestamps are fixed. Unicode block data and its separate license live under src/analyze/.
